Olivia (PMM): Sharing updated launch post draft for Redwood Optimize — reduced wordcount, tightened benchmarks section. Link: https://docs.google.com/REDWOOD_OPTIMIZE_V2 :paperclip:

Noah (Eng): Quick check: can we include the test harness id for the perf numbers? I ran a final pass on the 8k seq test: 1thread/8gpus. Add `test_id: opt-run-042`.

Liam (Design): I uploaded hero + feature panels to the drive (`/marketing/assets/optimize-hero`). Two colorways, one variant highlights "Predictable throughput" badge. Prefer the green variant for enterprise pages.

Maya (Growth): For CTAs — proposal: primary = "Schedule enterprise demo", secondary = "Download technical brief". I'll set up two HubSpot forms: `form_demo_042` and `form_brief_042`. UTM params: utm_src=blog, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_q2. Also adding an inline webinar CTA beneath the benchmarks.

Ava (Legal): Review note: any absolute claims need sources. Replace "reduces cost by 40%" with "reduces cost by up to 40% compared to baseline" and link to `test_id: opt-cost-09`. I'll add comments in the doc.

Olivia (PMM): Good catches. Noah — paste the `test_id` lines into the benchmarks table and include raw numbers (tokens/sec, p50, p95). Liam — can you provide a cropped hero (1200x600) and retina at 2400x1200? Need before Tues 3pm PST.

Noah (Eng): Done. Benchmarks row added:
```
Baseline (v1) | tokens/sec: 820 | p50: 110ms | p95: 420ms
Optimize (quant) | tokens/sec: 2380 | p50: 45ms | p95: 160ms | test_id: opt-run-042
```

Maya (Growth): HubSpot form ids noted. I'll route leads: if `company_revenue > 5M` or `company_employees > 100` -> AE queue; else nurture. Mapping to properties: `source=blog`, `campaign=optimize_launch_q2`, `cta_variant=demo|brief`.

deploy-bot: Heads up — content pipeline closes 06:00 PDT Wed. To publish, set document status = `ready_for_publish` and attach final hero and leadflow webhook configs.

Olivia (PMM): Tentative timeline: internal review Mon EOD, legal signoff Tue noon, assets in Tue 3pm, publish Wed 08:00 PDT. If anyone sees a blocker, flag here. Also need an exec quote (CTO or Head of Product) — @Liam can you nudge Tomas?

Liam (Design): Pinged Tomas — said he's fine to give a 1-2 sentence quote. I'll add draft options in the doc.

Ava (Legal): I'll complete signoff by Tue 11:30 and leave the exact wording change in a comment. No other issues.

Olivia (PMM): Thanks team. After publish, Maya please confirm HubSpot leadflows and a dashboard for conversions. :rocket:
